criterion.summary: Filter controls for marble type, finish, and use case are visible
criterion.details: - Filter panel accessible on gallery page - Desktop: horizontal filter bar or collapsible sidebar - Mobile: filter icon triggers bottom sheet or modal

criterion.summary: Selecting a filter updates URL params and re-fetches results
criterion.details: - URL format: ?marble=carrara-white&finish=polished&useCase=coffee-table - Page data re-fetches server-side on param change - No client-side flash during transition

criterion.summary: Multiple filters combine with AND logic
criterion.details: - Selecting marble + finish shows only items matching BOTH - All three filters can be applied simultaneously - Results narrow with each additional filter
- Selected filter options have distinct styling (gold accent or checked state) - Filter pill/chip shows active filters in filter bar - Badge/count shows number of active filters on mobile filter icon
- Button visible when any filter is active - Clicking clears URL params and shows all items - Button is styled as secondary action (not distracting)

criterion.summary: Empty results show friendly message with clear filters CTA
criterion.details: - Uses existing GalleryEmpty component - Message: "No results match your filters" - Prominent "Clear all filters" button - Optional: suggestion to try different filters

criterion.summary: URL is shareable/bookmarkable with filter state
criterion.details: - Copying URL and opening in new tab reproduces exact filter state - Filters persist through page refresh - Browser back/forward navigates filter history

Desktop: visible nav, side panels. Mobile: bottom sheet for filters. Breakpoints: Mobile <768px, Tablet 768-1024px, Desktop >1024px.

constraints.constraint: Server Components for data fetching - gallery page remains Server Component (ADR-005)
URL State - all filter state lives in URL search params, no client state needed
Server-side Filtering - Prisma queries filter at database level for performance
Filter controls must be keyboard navigable per WCAG 2.1 AA
Filter controls use shadcn Select component customized for Marmorani
Active filter state: gold accent border (#C9A962)
Smooth transitions on filter changes (0.3s ease-out)
All 5 locales must have filter translations (en, fr, de, es, it)
